title: What the Arm Reaches From Here: The Ring Around the Arm, Where the Base May Stop, and How Much Room It Leaves

questions.question: What does an arm reach, tool down, at one height?
options: A ring between an inner and an outer radius from its axis
questions.explanation: There is a hole in the middle.

questions.question: At -0.10 m below the mount the ring ran from:
questions.explanation: An inner and an outer radius.

questions.question: The quick test agreed with the full inverse kinematics on:
The tolerance for the base's stopping place was:
questions.explanation: Half the width of the ring.

questions.question: Why can the ring be found along one line?
options: The shoulder turns all the way round, so the reach is the same in every direction

questions.question: What is not checked by the ring?
options: The whole path to it, and targets that need the tool horizontal
